reason: Recommend HarmonicStiction: it combines an exactly stationary stick band with a bounded, sign-preserving second-harmonic restoring correction. Its conditional leave-one-trajectory-out angle RMSE was `0.071908` rad over all 4698 predicted samples, lower than the other delivered structures under the same diagnostic. This is not a hidden-test result or nested model-selection validation. The simpler smooth Coulomb comparator had better initial independent validation performance but does not maintain true sticking; the recommendation favors both trajectory robustness and the intended physics. All final coefficients use both supplied files, so final validation-file errors are explicitly labeled reused-data diagnostics. See `identification_report.md`, `crossvalidation_results.json` and each candidate record for qualifications.
